preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A + B)
preconditions.description: Strings A and B must contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: If conversion is impossible, output -1; otherwise, output the number of operations K followed by the operations.

postconditions.expression: any(all(A[i] == B[i] for i in range(N)) for _ in range(T))
postconditions.description: If A can be converted to B, ensure the output reflects the correct sequence of operations.

candidate_issues.instruction: Replace the expression to correctly reflect the output format for both impossible and successful conversions.
candidate_issues.task_evidence:
For each test case:
- If it is impossible to convert A to B, print a single line containing the integer -1.
- Otherwise, first, print a line containing a single integer K ― the minimum number of operations.
- Then, print K lines describing the operations.
